title: Colour Code
description: A lyric set as a row of flat printed squares, one colour per letter, beside a card decoder wheel with a riveted die-cut cover. Type and the line re-encodes, the new squares sliding into place. Hover a square and the paper disc turns under the cover, clicking through each letter until the one you are pointing at sits in the window.
intent: After Peter Saville's colour alphabet for New Order (Power, Corruption & Lies, Blue Monday, 1983): a private cipher that turns type into pure colour, decoded with a wheel printed on the sleeve. Own palette and own wheel. https://atlasrecords.co.uk/blogs/all-about-vinyl/blue-monday-secret-codes-in-records
